Swim: 3D car models

Every car and every traffic vehicle in Swim is built from a model shared on Sketchfab under the
Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Thank you to the artists.

Changes made for the game, to every model: maker badges, logos, lettering, number plates and most of the
interior removed; simplified to a lighter mesh (and a lighter phone version; each traffic vehicle also a lighter
far-away version, <type>-far.glb); turned, centred and rescaled;
materials replaced with the game's own (paint colour chosen in game). The models are provided as is, with no
warranties, as the licence says.

Racing cars (public/vendor/models/swim/cars):

  m3       (G80 Sedan): model by SLBofficial, https://sketchfab.com/SLBofficial, https://sketchfab.com/models/0550ac4d2a3846b3bb75370eb8ef84c1, CC BY 4.0
  supra    (A80 Coupe): model by supercarmodels, https://sketchfab.com/supercarmodels, https://sketchfab.com/models/74db03c309124369b785dca48c937b71, CC BY 4.0

Swim: engine sounds (public/audio/swim)

Every car you drive in Swim sounds like the real thing: its engine is built from field recordings shared under
Creative Commons, either CC0 (public domain, no credit needed, credited anyway) or the Attribution licence (CC BY 3.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/, or CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); the
Nissan GT-R's is under Attribution-ShareAlike (CC BY-SA 3.0, see its line below). Thank you to the people who
recorded them.

Changes made for the game, to every recording: pieces cut out (an idle, full-throttle pulls through the gears, lifts,
single exhaust bangs), made mono, levelled against the others and re-encoded as one small file per engine, with a map
of every engine cycle in them (public/audio/swim/<engine>.json). The game plays them back one engine cycle at a time
at the revs you are at, with a little drive and EQ of its own. Provided as is, with no warranties, as the licences say.

  turbo4 (FK8 Hatch, the Civic Type R's 2.0 turbo four): idle from "Honda Civic Type R FL5 with Tomei exhaust - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by Wishlist Project (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Honda_Civic_Type_R_FL5_with_Tomei_exhaust_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_c_Hkf8Z6LYM).opus, CC BY 3.0; pull from "Honda Civic Type R (FL5) - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by JAHSIN TIME (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Honda_Civic_Type_R_(FL5)_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_EVKAlCyqUkU).opus, CC BY 3.0; bangs from "Car Antilag (No cleanup, 32float)" by modusmogulus, https://freesound.org/s/797835/, CC0, and "car pass by - afterfire crackle-tune crackle map anti-lag street" by klankbeeld, https://freesound.org/s/873008/, CC BY 4.0
  v8 (Pony GT, the Mustang GT's 5.0 V8): pulls from "Ford Mustang GT (S550) - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by Cestni dirkač (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ford_Mustang_GT_(S550)_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_2ceiDjGgpI8).opus, CC BY 3.0; idle and bangs from "ford mustang v8 rear startup.wav" and "ford mustang v8 rear 4.wav" by pastori666, https://freesound.org/s/384055/ and https://freesound.org/s/384056/, CC BY 4.0; bangs from "Shelby GT500 (2012) - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by LUNI Classic Cars (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shelby_GT500_(2012)_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_Zc3gxBIXnXU).opus, CC BY 3.0
  inline6 (G80 Sedan, the M3's twin-turbo straight six): idle and bangs from "BMW M3 Competition with Fi Exhaust - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by FiExhaust (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BMW_M3_Competition_with_Fi_Exhaust_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_kUIorGHpeVg).opus, CC BY 3.0; pulls through the gears from "BMW M4 Competition - engine and exhaust sound" (its sister twin-turbo straight six), audio of a video by LA VLOGS (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:BMW_M4_Competition_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_cURoZmhp53c).opus, CC BY 3.0
  i6jz (A80 Coupe, the Supra's turbo straight six): "Import car revs on Chassis Dyno with Turbo.wav" by editboy23 (a Toyota Supra), https://freesound.org/s/496171/, CC0; bangs from "Toyota Supra (A80) - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by Fabio Rojas Pichardo (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Toyota_Supra_(A80)_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_YlRjnMnHRO4).opus, CC BY 3.0
  v6tt (Nissan GT-R, its twin-turbo 3.8 V6): "Nissan GT-R SpecV" by Edvvc (a 2009 GT-R SpecV pulling away at the Goodwood Festival of Speed), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nissan_GT-R_SpecV.ogg, CC BY-SA 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). Because of that licence, public/audio/swim/v6tt.mp3 (made from it) is itself shared under CC BY-SA 3.0 and may be reused on the same terms; bangs from "Car Antilag (No cleanup, 32float)" by modusmogulus, https://freesound.org/s/797835/, CC0
  v8sc (Blower, the Hellcat's supercharged V8): idle and a bang from "Dodge Challenger SRT" by JorisDJN, https://freesound.org/s/760645/, CC0; pulls and bangs from "Cadillac CT5-V Blackwing - engine and exhaust sound" (another supercharged 6.2 V8), audio of a video by Drag Racing Wheels - Forgestar - Weld - Race Stars (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cadillac_CT5-V_Blackwing_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_Dgo5_38A-S0).opus, CC BY 3.0; bangs from "Shelby GT500 (2012) - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by LUNI Classic Cars (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shelby_GT500_(2012)_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_Zc3gxBIXnXU).opus, CC BY 3.0
  v8c8 (C8, the Corvette's mid-engine V8): "Chevrolet Corvette Stingray - engine and exhaust sound" (a 2023 C8), audio of a video by Gripforce Clutches (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chevrolet_Corvette_Stingray_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_TiObDdbrbOs).opus, CC BY 3.0; bangs from the CT5-V Blackwing recording above, CC BY 3.0
  flat6 (992 Track, the 911 GT3's flat six): idle and low revs from "Porsche 911 GT3 RS (991) - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by Automotion Media (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Porsche_911_GT3_RS_(991)_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_otznJ2rBoks).opus, CC BY 3.0; revs under load from "Porsche 911 GT3 (997) - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by ProRallyVids (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Porsche_911_GT3_(997)_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_3WHXKH_Ouc).opus, CC BY 3.0
  v10 (Toro V10, the Huracán's 5.2 V10, shared with the Audi R8): "Audi R8 Idling Reving Backfire.wav" by Jonas_Jocys, https://freesound.org/s/457733/, CC BY 4.0, and "Audi_R8_01.wav" by ikbenraar, https://freesound.org/s/429099/, CC BY 4.0
  v8ft (Rosso V8, the 488's twin-turbo flat-plane V8, shared with the Portofino): "Ferrari Portofino - engine and exhaust sound", audio of a video by Hungarian Supercar Spotters (YouTube), https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ferrari_Portofino_-_engine_and_exhaust_sound_(YouTube_jNiYO5AYVlQ).opus, CC BY 3.0
